title: 第11章 修成气刃术玄牝空间第二妙用第12章 伤亡
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
“大长老爷爷，我来了！”
李青元一路疾驰，带起劲风。
大长老李光耀正在施展灵雨术浇灌药田，抬手之间，体内灵力发动，汇聚天地灵气与水气形成灵雨洒落。
施术一次后，他转身道：“你小子今天怎么有空来老夫这里？”
过去半年，李青元一直闭关、闭关、闭关，从不离开云霞山，更不去云霞小镇凡人世界玩耍。
大长老们十天半个月才能见到他一面。
李青元看了看四周，确定没有第三人，这才运转《大椿功》，释放炼气二层气息，笑道：“大长老爷爷，您老是不是该教我法术了。”
“炼气二层！？”大长老李光耀瞪大眼睛，愣愣指着李青元道：“你、你小子竟然突破到了炼气二层？”
“这怎么可能？”
大长老差点咬到自己舌头，难以置信道：“才半年你就炼气二层了？”
李青元嘿嘿一笑：“你们都说了，我是天才嘛。”
“既然是天才，自然出人意料。”
大长老说道：“可你这速度，也太出人意料了吧。”
原本，他们几人猜测，李青元一年左右应该可以达到炼气一层圆满，然后开始准备冲击炼气二层。
他没想到，李青元达到炼气二层的时间，竟然缩短了一半多。
其实吧，他们的预料也没错。
但是，因为玄牝空间，因为资源翻倍，修炼速度也成倍提升。
“哈哈哈，天佑李家，天佑李家。”大长老欣喜道：“好孩子，你果然是个天才。”
“说吧，想学什么，老夫都教你。”
“嗯…”李青元想了想，问道：“大长老爷爷，咱们家族都有哪些法术啊？”

“我父亲他只会两三种法术，您老呢？”
大长老捋了捋胡须，傲娇小老头上线，得意道：“我们李氏仙族，一共掌控六种一阶法术。”
“法术等级，分为一阶、二阶、三阶……”
“一阶法术，适用于炼气期。二阶法术，适用于筑基期。至于三阶法术，只有传说中的结丹真人才能修炼成功。”
“咱们族内的六种一阶法术，分别是——气刃术、火球术、土甲术，灵雨术、月影术、铁臂术。”
“第一种，气刃术——凝炼自身灵气，聚气成刃，将其化作一道气刃杀出。切金断玉、锋利无比。”
李青元点头道：“听起来很厉害的样子。”
大长老继续道：“灵雨术，普及很广，这是专为灵植夫量身打造的法术，修炼此术主要是为了灌溉灵田和种植灵药。”
“火球术，高度凝炼自身灵气，化作火球杀出。在修仙界，火球术是普及度最高的一阶法术。”
“土甲术，灵气化甲，固若金汤，是防御类法术。”
“铁臂术，双臂铁化，力大如牛，可攻可守。”
content_en:
"Great Elder Grandpa, I'm here!"
Li Qingyuan galloped all the way, bringing strong wind.
The Great Elder Lee Kuan Yew was using the Spiritual Rain Technique to water the medicinal field. As he raised his hand, the spiritual power in his body was activated, gathering the spiritual energy and water vapor of heaven and earth to form spiritual rain.
After performing the technique once, he turned around and said, "Why do you have time to come to my place today?"
In the past six months, Li Qingyuan has been in retreat, retreat, retreat, never leaving Yunxia Mountain, let alone playing in the mortal world of Yunxia Town.
It takes ten days and a half for the great elders to see him.
Li Qingyuan looked around and made sure there was no third person. Then he started to use the "Dachun Gong", released the second level of Qi Refining, and said with a smile: "Grandpa Elder, it's time for you to teach me spells."
"Second level of Qi refining!?" Grand Elder Li Guangyao's eyes widened, and he pointed at Li Qingyuan blankly and said, "You, your kid actually broke through to the second level of Qi refining?"
"How is this possible?"
The great elder almost bit his own tongue and said in disbelief: "You have reached the second level of Qi refining in just half a year?"
Li Qingyuan chuckled: "You all said that I am a genius."
"Since he is a genius, he is naturally unexpected."
The Great Elder said: "But your speed is too unexpected."
Originally, several of them guessed that Li Qingyuan should be able to reach the first level of Qi Refining in about a year, and then start preparing to attack the second level of Qi Refining.
He did not expect that the time it took Li Qingyuan to reach the second level of Qi Refining was shortened by more than half.
Actually, their predictions were right.
However, because of the mysterious female space, because the resources are doubled, the cultivation speed is also doubled.
"Hahaha, God bless the Li family, God bless the Li family." The elder said happily: "Good boy, you are indeed a genius."
"Tell me, whatever you want to learn, I will teach you."
"Hmm..." Li Qingyuan thought for a while and asked, "Grandpa Grandpa, what kind of spells does our family have?"
"My father only knows two or three kinds of magic. How about you?"
The great elder stroked his beard, and the arrogant little old man came online and said proudly: "We, the Li Clan, control a total of six first-level spells."
"Spell levels are divided into first level, second level, third level..."
"The first-level spells are suitable for the Qi refining period. The second-level spells are suitable for the foundation-building period. As for the third-level spells, only the legendary Master Jiedan can successfully cultivate them."
"The six first-level spells in our clan are - air blade, fireball, earth armor, spiritual rain, moon shadow, and iron arm."
"The first is the air blade technique - condense your own spiritual energy, gather the energy into a blade, and turn it into an air blade to kill. It can cut through gold and jade, and is extremely sharp."
Li Qingyuan nodded and said: "It sounds very powerful."
The Great Elder continued: "The Spiritual Rain Technique is very popular. It is a spell specially designed for spiritual planters. The main purpose of practicing this technique is to irrigate spiritual fields and plant elixirs."
"Fireball is a technique that highly condenses one's spiritual energy and turns it into a fireball. In the world of immortality, Fireball is the most popular first-order spell."
"The Earth Armor Technique, where spiritual energy turns into armor, is impregnable and is a defensive spell."
"Iron Arm Technique, the arms are made of iron and are as strong as an ox, and can be used both offensively and defensively."
